{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the QA orders
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99')
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check unique values in channel
print(f'Channels: {df["channel"].unique()}')

# Check unique values in customer_segment
print(f'Segments: {df["customer_segment"].unique()}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f'Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df["customer_age"] == -1).sum()}')

# Check revenue format
print(f'First 5 revenue values: {df["revenue"].head(5).tolist()}')"}
